page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Main text runs full width, with a heading "CAPUT XXI." in spaced capitals and a paragraph opening with a large initial. Catchword "præua-" at the right below the last line. Gathering mark "o" at the left below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: libet in speciem sapienter ab hominibus præter verbum Dei excogitatos, qui iram numinis placare, aut mala à capitibus nostris prohibere queant. 3. Multò minus sperandum, quòd humanis consiliis & sapientia ulla possint auerti mala, quæ Dominus immittere semel constituerit. 4. Humanas enim mentes subinde excæcari, & pro spiritu sapientiæ succedere spiritum uertiginosum, qui miris artibus imponit, & uiros fallit uel præstantissimos. 5. At interim in omnibus periculis & flagellis Dominum suorum habere rationem, ac seruare perquàm lubenter quasdam reliquias,è quibus sibi electam paret Ecclesiolam, quæ constare debet ex omnis generis hominibus, tam Gentilibus quàm Iudæis. 6. Quinetiam præcipua officia credentium in sancta Dei Ecclesia, luculenter descripta hic habemus: 7. Præterea, quomodo Dominus dignatur sæpe & variis modis præmonere, antequam feriat seu castiget, si forte resipiscant & veniam petant, qui flagella sunt commeriti. 8. Postremò, quòd aliorum successus tam lætos quàm aduersos in exemplum nobis prudenter debeamus proponere, & ex alienis periculis cauti, ex aliena felicitate erecti fieri.
main_text.head: CAPUT XXI.
main_text.p: ONus deserti maris: sicut tempestates in meridie (excitatæ,) quę transeunt ut veniant à deserto, de terra horribili. Visio dura annúciata est mihi: (veniat)

page.notes: The first paragraph continues from the previous page; its numbered sections 3–8 run on inline within it as printed. The lines "7. Præterea" and "8. Postremò" are not indented, so I kept them in the same paragraph. The initial O of "Onus" is a large woodcut-style letter, transcribed as printed. "Quinetiam" has a printed flourish over the Q, read as Q. Pagination reads 209 at top right.
